dedupe_keys.name: ifpri food security portal food price volatility export restrictions tracker and fertilizer market dashboards

description: The Food Security Portal is IFPRI's hub of data and tools for monitoring global food markets and food crises. The International Food Policy Research Institute runs it, with regional subportals for Africa south of the Sahara and for Asia and the Pacific. Tools include the Excessive Food Price Volatility early warning tool for staple commodities, a weekly fertilizer volatility indicator and fertilizer market dashboard, and the Food and Fertilizer Export Restrictions Tracker, which records trade policy measures by country and the share of traded calories restricted, compiled in collaboration with the WTO Secretariat. The portal also links food crisis risk monitoring, nutrition and modelling and scenario tools and hosts analysis of shocks such as the Black Sea tensions and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz. Coverage is global with country detail. Tools and data views are free online, and some tables can be downloaded. Caveats: it is a portal combining several tools with different methods and update cycles, some series are shown only as charts, and the export restriction tracker records announced measures, not trade volumes. Simulation uses: building food trade shock and export ban scenarios, tracking price and fertilizer volatility as triggers for supply disruption models, and validating food system stress tests. Related records: the EU Agri-food data portal (data-eu-agri-food-data-portal-agricultural-markets) gives European market series and FEWS NET (data-fews-net-data-explorer) gives early warning outlooks.
